jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Work Authorization**
----------------------


**No sponsorship available. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future visa sponsorship.**


**Summary**
-----------


Capgemini is seeking a Senior Program Manager \- MarTech Delivery Lead to lead large\-scale marketing technology and digital experience initiatives for a leading Financial Services client.


This role combines enterprise program leadership with deep MarTech expertise and requires experience delivering Adobe Experience Cloud solutions across complex, large\-scale organizations.


The ideal candidate will possess a blend of program leadership, stakeholder management, and experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Target, personalization, digital experience, and customer engagement platforms.


**Required Experience**
-----------------------


* 15\+ years of technology delivery, program management, or portfolio leadership experience.
* Proven success leading complex enterprise programs involving multiple workstreams, stakeholders, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Experience delivering MarTech, Digital Experience, Personalization, Customer Engagement, or Adobe Experience Cloud initiatives.
* Strong experience with:
* + Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
	+ Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
	+ Adobe Target
* Experience managing program scope, financials, risks, dependencies, governance, and executive communications.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and Business organizations.
* Strong Agile delivery experience.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence.
**Preferred Experience**
------------------------


* SAFe experience including:
* + PI Planning
	+ Agile Release Trains (ART)
	+ Release Management
* Adobe Campaign
* Adobe Analytics
* Financial Services, Insurance, Wealth Management, Asset Management, or other regulated industry experience.
* Experience with personalization, omnichannel experiences, digital transformation, APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and enterprise integrations.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, or equivalent certifications.
**Key words:**
--------------


Adobe Experience Manager, AEM, Adobe Experience Platform, AEP, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Cloud, MarTech, Marketing Technology, Personalization, Omnichannel, Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Agile Release Train, ART, PI Planning, Program Management, Portfolio Management, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Delivery, Financial Services

jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager - Wallet & Apple Pay
jobs.description:
The Wallet \& Apple Pay PMO is looking for a driven, design\-minded Engineering Project Manager to help ship experiences used by hundreds of millions of people every day. This is an exciting environment where technical fluency, design partnership, and sound judgment under ambiguity are keys to success. If you possess unshakeable integrity, genuine curiosity, and the range to move seamlessly between leadership briefings and engineering triage, we'd love to hear from you!  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will manage projects and support roadmap execution for the Wallet client engineering teams, focusing on delivering the UI and experiences that bring new Wallet capabilities to life. You will partner directly with engineering managers, Human Interface producers, and cross\-functional groups across Apple. Under the guidance of PMO leadership, you will help drive the scoping, planning, and execution of key initiatives \- coordinating design deliverables against engineering milestones and ensuring teams stay aligned so features launch on time and at the quality our users expect.","responsibilities":"Work closely with the app engineers responsible for building the Wallet UI to plan, track, and manage the development of features and release of our software.  

  

Partner with our Human Interface producers and designers to plan design deliverables against engineering milestones, ensuring specs, assets, and design decisions land in time to keep development on schedule.  

  

Coordinate cross\-functional work streams spanning engineering, design, and quality, and represent program status to stakeholders at all levels.  

  

Proactively surface risk, drive timely decisions, and unblock teams \- including navigating the privacy, security, and financial\-partner review cycles specific to your domain.  

  

Own release quality and stability commitments for the client UI, balancing engineering constraints against design fidelity and timeline.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience partnering with mobile/native client engineering teams (iOS, Android, or embedded) through the full build\-test\-release cycle.  

  

Familiarity with modern engineering workflows, including standard bug\-tracking systems, GitHub, and AI\-assisted development tools  

  

Prior experience mentoring or setting process direction for other EPMs.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\+ years of project management experience in a technical software development environment, including experience coordinating with design or design\-production teams.  

  

Strong track record coordinating cross\-functional work streams across engineering, design, and quality to deliver high quality features with minimal supervision, at a company/product operating at large scale.  

  

Experience managing feature delivery in regulated or high\-consequence domains with compliance, security, or bank/financial\-partner review gates (e.g., payments, identity, or health).  

  

Proven ability to proactively identify risks, drive decision\-making, and unblock teams.  

  

Demonstrated ability to navigate technical ambiguity, triage development bugs, and drive cross\-functional decision\-making under minimal supervision.  

  

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.  

  

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Our mission is to create the Experience of a Lifetime for our employees, so they can, in turn, create the Experience of a Lifetime for our guests. We own and operate the most renowned destination resorts in the world as well as regional and local ski areas outside major cities, and connect them all through one unrivaled network. We are looking for ambitious leaders, innovators and creators to join our talented team. If you’re ready to pursue your fullest potential, we want to get to know you!

  

Candidates for year\-round positions are reviewed on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted up to 90 days after the posting date, or until the position is filled (whichever is first).

 **Job Summary:**


Retail Technology is looking for a curious and dynamic Business Analyst to join Vail Resorts’ rapidly growing Retail Applications Group. As a partner to the Retail, Rental, Operations departments within the organization, this individual will help support the technology at each of the 250 retail locations, focused on a core suite of Retail Applications including ERP (inventory, distribution, buying, etc.), reporting and point\-of\-sale functionality. Working cross\-functionally with Merchandising, Operations, Warehousing, Accounting, Ecommerce, and other areas of IT, this person is a key contributor supporting production system health and delivering key IT enhancements.

  

The ideal candidate for this role is excited to help a team improve, develop, and implement SDLC (Software Dev Life Cycle) and customer service best practices in a uniquely complex environment. They will be comfortable moving between the technical analyst, business analyst and quality assurance spaces, as this role requires flexibility between each of those disciplines. This position brings value to the organization through thought leadership, technical acumen, process design, business partnership, and collaboration with our 3rd party development partners. We are looking for a candidate that enjoys troubleshooting in the field as much as they enjoy facilitating business requirements.

 **Job Specifications:**

* Starting Wage: $89,348\.00 \- $105,000\.00 \+ Annual Bonus
* Employment Type: Year Round
* Shift Type: Full Time hours available
* Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age
* Housing Availability: No
 **Job Responsibilities:**

 Production Management

* Assess severity/priority of production issues, determine business impact, and communicate progress during resolution with high proficiency.
* Remediate issue tickets following ITIL practices across retail systems, server integration points, access provisioning and more.
* Ensure all system changes meet change control, testing, and documentation standards, maintaining system stability and compliance, while supporting business priorities.
* Responsible for proactive production monitoring and dashboard development
* Executes, optimizes and ensures all SOX (Sarbanes Oxley), PCI (Payment Card Industry) and DSR (Data Subject Request) tasks are completed thoroughly with a high attention to detail.
* Subject Matter Expert and Process Owner technically supporting multiple business and IT groups.
* High technical aptitude using SQL, data monitoring and job management tools to troubleshoot complex issues.


 Enhancement Delivery

* Identify and deliver key system enhancements to improve system stability and business functions.
* Ensure all enhancement work follows the SDLC process, meets SOX (Sarbanes Oxley) and PCI (Payment Card Industry) requirements, and maintain all required compliance documentation.
* Proficient in QA (Quality Assurance) Life Cycle by developing test plans and test scripts, documenting test results, and reporting on results while coordinating usage of test environments.
* Peer reviewer for requirements and test plan documentation for bug and enhancement work aligning to SDLC practices.


 Stakeholder Management

* Build strong relationships with third\-party vendors, IT partners, and business stakeholders to proactively support our production environment and deliver on enhancement tasks.
* Facilitate and own business stakeholder’s backlog management for enhancements following SDLC practices.
 **Job Requirements:**

* 5\+ years of demonstrated IT business analysis or production support experience following ITIL practices.
* Ability to remediate technical issues thoroughly with quality customer support and clear communication
* Ability to deliver system enhancements using SDLC methodologies while leading through requirements, design, and testing process
* **MS Development Technologies, including PowerShell, SQL Server, SSRS, SSIS**
* **Prior application ownership experience** (Ex: Aptos POS, Sales Audit, CRM, Loss Prevention, MMS, Oracle Retail, Manhattan Associates, SAP, Silvon, IT connect, ServiceNow)
* Strong **SQL** and system diagraming skills
* Effective communication \& interpersonal skills; comfortable speaking with and translating between technical and non\-technical team members at all levels of the organization
* Strong documentation skills
* Keen attention to detail, ensuring high quality application deployments
* Ability to manage multiple technical enhancements as well as application maintenance
* Ability to work in fast paced environment, comfortable with shifting priorities
* Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related concentration

**Preferred:**

* IT Experience in retail, outdoor industry, or hospitality field
* Prior **APTOS, MMS,** or similar software application experience
* Exposure to a wide variety of database technology including **AS/400 \& DB2** in addition to more modern platforms.
* Experience with Analytics tools – **SSAS, SSRS, SAS, Tableau, Alteryx**
* Strong Excel skills – **Macros, VBA, Advanced Formulas**
* Work order system experience, such as Ivanti, Jira, etc.
* PMI\-BA, PMI\-ACP, IIBA, PSPO, POPM, ITIL or other accredited certification or coursework is a plus

* Strong understanding of federal procurement regulations (FAR) and IT acquisition processes.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities with high attention to detail.
* Proficiency with SEWP portals, reporting tools, and business systems.
